Campaign report · phase 1 organic launch

Legacy Optical Noir

A premium, approval-ready campaign plan for launching the Noir visual territory through organic Instagram posts, branded assets, reply scripts, and success criteria before any paid media spend.

01 · Campaign summary

Why and how this campaign is planned

Legacy Noir is designed as a low-friction social launch: premium product visuals first, simple captions, fast reply handling, and clear daily checks. The campaign builds demand before paid ads by proving which frames, messages, and visual angles generate saves, replies, profile visits, and sales conversations.

Scope: Phase 1 covers organic Instagram publishing, client-facing post assets, captions, basic reply scripts, and manual performance evaluation. Paid ads are intentionally out of scope and reserved for Phase 2, where revenue from Phase 1 can be reinvested into tested winners.

High-level timeline

Day 0
Approve
Client approves image set, logo treatment, captions, and posting window.
Days 1–10
Publish
Six Instagram feed posts go live across alternating day/time windows.
Daily
Respond
DMs and comments use short scripts designed to move interest into model selection.
Day 11
Evaluate
Review saves, replies, profile actions, inquiries, holds, and sales conversations.

03 · Messages and replies

Response scripts for comments and DMs

The reply system keeps the brand premium but operational: acknowledge the signal, confirm availability, offer a narrow next step, and move the prospect toward a model/color choice or visit.

Availability

Yes — tell us which Noir frame caught your eye and we’ll confirm the closest available model/color.

Price / range

They’re premium pieces. Send us the model you liked and we’ll share the current price plus one alternative in the same mood.

Try-on / visit

Absolutely. We can help you pick two options before you visit so the selection is faster and more personal.

Hold / reserve

We can hold the option once availability is confirmed. Want us to check this frame or send two similar picks?

04 · Campaign evaluation

Success criteria and decision gates

Primary signals

  • Qualified DMs or comments asking for model, price, availability, or visit.
  • Post saves and shares indicating style intent beyond passive likes.
  • Profile visits and link/profile actions during the posting window.
  • Holds, visits, or sales conversations attributed to Noir posts.

Phase 2 readiness

  • Select the top 1–2 organic posts by saves, replies, and commercial intent.
  • Confirm which caption angle produced the strongest buyer conversation.
  • Only reinvest into ads once organic winners and available inventory are clear.
  • Document proof: post URLs, screenshots, metrics, replies, and next action.
